pr.title: perf(cake_xqa): add the tcgen05/TMEM cluster-multicast D512 tree routes to experimental SM110 XQA
pr.body:
> Developed by the **CAKE team**, the kernels in this PR **outperform** the relevant **SOTA baselines at the time of merge** on the **vast majority of performance benchmark shapes**, matching them otherwise.

Developed by the **CAKE team**, the new D512 tree-attention kernels in this PR **outperform** the relevant **SOTA baselines at the time of merge** across **all four reported cache modes on Thor**, using the pooled cold-L2 results.

## Summary

Adds the `tmem` kernel family to the experimental SM110 XQA package: the D512 tree attention schedule on the
tcgen05 tensor-memory accumulator path, one 128-row Q tile x one 256-column output half per 512-thread CTA, with
Q and K/V fetched once per thread-block cluster by TMA multicast. It is exported for all four D512 cache modes
(FP16/FP8 x page128/contiguous) at GQA ratio 8 (Hq = 8 x Hkv, the validated shape family; the frozen trace is
specialised per ratio) and `kernel="auto"` now selects it there, because under the strict cold-L2 protocol it beats
both the previous kernel of record (`register_mma_auto`, PRs #5293 / #5597) and the upstream TensorRT Edge XQA
source on every cache mode on every validated Thor node. Other GQA ratios keep the `register_mma_auto` selection
under `auto`, and `kernel="tmem"` rejects them with a `ValueError`.

- `csrc/sm110_xqa/sm_110a/sm110_xqa_tree_<mode>_tmem_{kernel,q_kernel,binding}.cu` for the four modes: generated
  sm_110a source of the Cake tree kernel module (`edge_xqa_tree_tmem`) in its two cluster forms. The `(2, 2, 1)`
  form pairs the two Q tiles of one KV head so K/V and Q are each fetched once per cluster; the `(2, 1, 1)` form
  (`*_q_kernel.cu`, symbol suffix `_q`) multicasts Q only and serves heads with an odd Q-tile count. Cluster
  dimensions are compiled into each kernel; the binding picks the form from the parity of `ceil(q_len * ratio / 128)`,
  encodes the Q and K/V TMA descriptors from the same tensors the other routes already receive, and launches with
  the ordinary runtime API (grid `(2, heads * tiles, batch)`, 230400 B dynamic shared memory).
- `manifest.json`: four `tree_*_tmem` routes (`tile_rows=128`, `output_tile_columns=256`, `block=[512,1,1]`,
  `cluster=[2,2,1]`, `fallback_cluster=[2,1,1]`, `kernel_symbol` + `fallback_kernel_symbol`, both cubin digests,
  `nvcc_options=["--use_fast_math"]`), sixteen ledger rows, refreshed ledger digest.
- `jit.py`: fourth tree kernel family with its own route suffix and geometry contract; fourteen base routes.
- `backend.py`: `kernel="tmem"` and `kernel="auto"` (the tmem route for every D512 cache mode).
  `register_mma`, `register_mma_split` and `register_mma_auto` keep their previous meaning.
- `benchmarks/sm110_xqa_shapes.json`: four `tree_*_tmem` ledger rows.
- Tests: tmem cache cases on all four modes incl. odd and even Q-tile counts (both cluster forms), `auto` routing
  at ratio 8, the register-route fallback of `auto` and the `tmem` rejection off ratio 8, JIT fixture for the new
  family (`gqa_ratio` geometry field). README, RESULTS.md and validation.json record the route and the Thor validation.

No existing route, source file or manifest route entry changes; the `tcgen05`, `register_mma` and
`register_mma_split` routes are untouched.

## Speedup vs baselines (shipped `auto` route = `tmem`, strict cold-L2 CUPTI medians)

Strict cold = a 64 MiB L2 flush before every launch; A = the previous kernel of record (`register_mma_auto` +
KV L2 prefetch, PRs #5293 / #5597); B = the upstream TensorRT Edge XQA source. Each cell is the median ratio over
independent processes (two to four per node, four alternating pairs each); ledger shape (batch 1, 20 query tokens,
32 query heads, 4 KV heads, D512, capacity 256, causal tree mask).

| mode | vs A node 1 (0679) | vs A node 2 (0669) | vs A node 3 (0667) | vs A node 4 (0666) | vs B (minimum over nodes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FP8 page128 | 1.058 / 1.056 | 1.038 / 1.078 | 1.049 / 1.075 | - | 1.13 |
| FP8 contiguous | 1.062 / 1.074 | 1.039 / 1.051 | 1.071 / 1.053 | - | 1.20 |
| FP16 page128 | 1.116 / 1.094 | 1.115 / 1.082 | 1.149 / 1.130 | - | 1.31 |
| FP16 contiguous | 1.052 / 1.050 | 1.032 / 0.993 | 1.029 / 1.020 / 0.997 / 1.026 (pooled 1.02) | 1.012 / 1.050 / 1.035 (pooled 1.035) | 1.35 |

FP16 contiguous was re-measured on two further nodes after one process on node 2 read 0.993: pooled over all pairs
it is > 1 on every node and 13 of 15 independent processes read > 1 (the two below sit inside the +-0.03 per-process
band). Warm-L2 numbers are attribution only: the cluster multicast lever targets the cold L2->SM inflow and is
neutral to slightly positive warm.

## Kernel-side gates (both Thor node classes, CUDA 13.4, sm_110a)

- Seven qualification rows (three D128 decode rows, four D512 modes) at the package tolerances
  (FP16 `atol=rtol=1e-2`, FP8 `atol=rtol=0.1`), max abs error 1.2e-4; the e2e slice (28 tests per node) passes.
- Bit-deterministic: two direct launches, four CUDA-graph replays and a side-stream eager launch produce identical
  bytes on all four cache forms.
- compute-sanitizer synccheck: 0 errors on all four forms on three nodes; racecheck reaches the 20 s deadline on
  every form (skipped by protocol, no result); memcheck not run.
- Static census: 128 registers, no local memory, 5.4-5.6k SASS instructions per form.

## FlashInfer-side validation (Thor, one container session; recorded in `RESULTS.md` / `validation.json`)

Validation on NVIDIA Thor `sr250v3-0666` (20 SMs, CUDA 13.4, PyTorch 2.15.0a0+875d815502.nvinternal.main), one container session:

- Artifact parity (frozen schedule launcher vs the TVM-FFI export, identical tensors, six alternating pairs, 256 CUPTI cold-L2 samples per round, gate 3%): FP16 contiguous 30.576 vs 30.368 us (0.68%), FP16 page128 30.640 vs 30.768 us (0.42%), FP8 contiguous 23.752 vs 23.728 us (0.10%), FP8 page128 24.000 vs 23.856 us (0.60%); all four rows pass.
- Public ledger benchmark (`benchmarks/bench_sm110_xqa.py`, 16 rows in one process): `tree_fp16_contiguous_tmem` 31.168 us (vs 31.408 `_mma`), `tree_fp16_paged_tmem` 29.712 us (vs 34.687 `_mma_split`), `tree_fp8_contiguous_tmem` 23.887 us (vs 24.544 `_mma`), `tree_fp8_paged_tmem` 24.288 us (vs 25.760 `_mma`); every row correct.
- compute-sanitizer on the exported routes, 20 s limit: synccheck 0 errors and racecheck 0 hazards (0 errors, 0 warnings) on all four modes, 8-10 s each.
- Tests in the container: JIT metadata suite 35 passed; GPU suite 177 passed, 8 skipped (the tmem parametrizations at GQA ratios 4 and 16, which the route rejects by design); pre-commit clean.

## Baselines and their source PRs

- `register_mma` routes (A for FP8 and FP16 contiguous): PR #5293 (merged d7e03f5e, 2026-09-27).
- `register_mma_split` route + `register_mma_auto` (A for FP16 page128): PR #5597 (merged 2026-09-28).
- `tcgen05` routes: PR #5293, untouched here.
- Upstream TensorRT Edge XQA source (B): pinned revision e8b29522 of the TensorRT Edge-LLM XQA kernel, built and
  timed in the same process by the Cake benchmark harness; not part of this repository.
- Branch merge-base: upstream `main` at 422a5ea6; no upstream commit after the merge-base touches
  `flashinfer/experimental/sm110_xqa` or `tests/experimental/sm110_xqa`.

## Test plan

- [ ] `pytest tests/experimental/sm110_xqa/test_sm110_xqa_jit.py` (CPU)
- [ ] `pytest tests/experimental/sm110_xqa/test_sm110_xqa.py` on Thor (CUDA 13.x, compute capability 11.0)
- [ ] pre-commit (ruff, mypy, end-of-file-fixer) clean
